title: Fix rounds that change a settled contract must update the brief before review
body: Outcome: krn review or krn verify refuses when the brief's mtime is older than a commit that changes an Allowed path after the first worker round, or the lead skill makes the brief update a numbered step. Evidence: #211 attempt-1 prepass BLOCKING 'Dangling paths without extensions are skipped' was a deliberate fix-round rule absent from the brief and lens (.krn/runs/lead/memory-refs/review1.log).
